scope: Implement Google Vids native asynchronous download with explicit pending/completed/error outcomes and one-poll continuation; preserve original Google Drive fetch paths and all master tasks
contract: POST files/{id}/download exactly once for Vids
done absent/null/false means pending, never fake content
fetch(operation_name,file_id,resource_key) polls the same operation once and never restarts download
completed initial response consumed without another poll
operation name/source remains explicit; resumed content is not falsely attributed to newly queried file metadata
known canonical operation error mapped to known tool failure without raw private details
Google-owned final URI only; no arbitrary user URL, OAuth only original fixed API origin, resource keys only trusted Google hosts
same request/response/deadline budgets, no internal sleeps/retries/model restart
verification: Targeted CPU schema/local HTTP/transport checks, existing affected Drive and provider reads; no GPU or actual account use
